summary: Phase B+C of Course Study Groups verified end-to-end. BACKEND (pytest 15/15 passed): (1) Student scope — GET /api/lectures/{course_id} with a group-1 student returns only the no-group section lectures + own group's lectures; group-2 lecture is correctly hidden; admin sees both. (2) Teacher scope — teacher-role user whose teacher_record_id = group-1 teacher sees group-1 lecture via /api/lectures/today (empty list OK, no crash), /api/lectures/all-schedule?date=... and /api/lectures/month/{y}/{m}, but NOT group-2's lecture (assigned to a different teacher) — _teacher_lecture_scope and _attach_group_courses behave correctly. (3) generate-semester with group='1' and group='2' at same slot runs in parallel (different teachers), stamps lectures with group/group_name/teacher_id, invalid group -> 400, re-run same group -> 0 new + already_exist>=1, no reflection to weekly schedule for group runs (gen_group bypasses _reflect_recurring_to_weekly). (4) Templates — POST /courses/{id}/groups/save-template returns {id,students_count=72,groups:[2]}; empty name -> 400; GET /templates lists with match_count+same_section+is_source+enrolled_count and template appears as is_source=true; apply-template on sibling course (same dept/level/section) copies groups+teachers; DELETE /group-templates/{id} works; delete nonexistent -> 404. FRONTEND (admin Playwright): group-templates-box visible on course-groups modal; tpl-save-toggle shows tpl-name-input + tpl-save-btn and saves a template; new tpl-row-{id} appears with tpl-apply-{id} + tpl-delete-{id}. On /course-lectures (auto-generate modal) generate-group-section + generate-group-all + generate-group-1 + generate-group-2 all visible and clickable. On /schedule a seeded group-1 lecture renders schedule-group-{lectureId} badge. my-lecture-group-{id} testID present in source (my-lectures.tsx line 83) but /lectures/today is not the actual route — the tab lives under /(tabs)/my-lectures.

issues: Pre-existing non-blocking console warning: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' recurs on multiple screens.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py has become 18,950 lines — way beyond the 700-line guideline. The lecture-scope + group logic now lives mid-file; recommend splitting lectures routes into /routes/lectures_*.py modules.

Active-semester handling is subtle: course view (/lectures/{course_id}) filters by the course's own semester window, while /today, /all-schedule, /month filter by the globally-active semester (via _alas). The two can diverge (seen here: course semester 'الفصل الثاني' is closed while active semester is 'الفصل الصيفي 2024-2025' with no dates). Group lectures must be stamped with the appropriate semester_id or they vanish from one view. Consider documenting this in a one-liner near _teacher_lecture_scope.

course_groups.py apply-template adds groups+optionally teachers but does NOT remove groups that exist in the course but are absent from the template. That is a conscious choice (idempotent merge) — document it in the endpoint docstring to avoid confusion.

deleteTemplate in CourseGroupsModal uses window.confirm — Playwright/automation requires a dialog handler; consider swapping for an in-app confirmation modal for better testability and consistent UX across native/web.
my-lectures.tsx uses `shadow*` style props which emit deprecation warnings on web (pre-existing).
